operations.pseudocode_formatting: Decode literal newlines and trim trailing whitespace only.

limits: Bounded raw import; no PE-wide callers, surrounding body or engine callbacks are supplied.
Decompiler bad-data halts mark omitted outgoing continuations, not observed native faults.
Exact-byte instruction fixtures own source admission, exit destinations, death state and removal behavior; generic decompiler ABI/type guesses are not implementation contracts.
